thread:
jess: FYI a fintech customer (finledger) reported streaming tool_call args being cut mid-JSON; payments webhook failing.
kevin: can you paste the raw stream capture? suspect chunk boundary issue.
jess: here's the TCP capture excerpt they shared:
```
data: {"name":"process_payment","args":{"amount":250.00,"currency":"USD","payer":
```
then next data line:
```
data: "{\"method\":\"card\",\"token\":\"tok_live_9x\"}"
```
maria: looks like the second `data:` contains an escaped JSON string rather than continued object — client parsed each data line independently and tried json.loads -> fails.
sam: runtime logs for req=req-fin-01 show `ToolCallParser: JSONDecodeError: Unterminated string starting at` then we fallback to text gen.
kevin: repro I ran using nginx as a reverse proxy with `chunked_transfer_encoding` on; nginx split the SSE payload into two `data:` lines. local client that treats each `data:` as a full message fails.
kevin: quick repro snippet:
```
# simulate server side sending chunks
printf "data: {\"name\":\"process_payment\",\"args\":{\"amount\":5"\n; sleep 0.1
printf "data: .00,\"currency\":\"USD\",\"payer\":{\"method\":\"card\"}}\n"
```
jess: customer wants a hotfix; they can't change their proxy easily.
maria: short-term mitigation: ask them to set `proxy_buffering off` or increase buffer sizes; or use websocket stream which doesn't split like SSE.
kevin: proposed server-side fixes:
- buffer SSE `data:` lines for `tool_call` events and try to parse only when buffer yields valid JSON (accumulate + incremental parse)
- add `event: tool_call_json` marker so clients concatenate `data:` lines for that event type
- detect and unescape double-encoded JSON payloads like `"{\"...\"}"`
sam: I'll set up a 5% canary on staging once patch is up; we'll monitor `ToolCallParser` error rate and p95 latency.
jess: action items:
- kevin: implement buffering + robust parse (PR in 48h)
- sam: canary config + dashboards (72h)
- maria: customer communication + workaround steps (24h)
ops-bot: created INC-3312 and assigned to eng-runtime
deploy-bot: scheduled staging deploy after CI
kevin: note: will add unit tests for fragmented `data:` lines and integration test with nginx chunked upstream.
jess: thanks everyone; i'll update the customer after staging canary shows no regressions.
